The region of the selected workspace. The default value will use the Region selection above.

properties.displayName: Process Create ASIM filtering parser for Halcyon
properties.query:
let parser = (starttime:datetime=datetime(null), endtime:datetime=datetime(null), commandline_has_any:dynamic=dynamic([]), commandline_has_all:dynamic=dynamic([]), commandline_has_any_ip_prefix:dynamic=dynamic([]), actingprocess_has_any:dynamic=dynamic([]), targetprocess_has_any:dynamic=dynamic([]), parentprocess_has_any:dynamic=dynamic([]), targetusername_has:string='*', dvcipaddr_has_any_prefix:dynamic=dynamic([]), dvchostname_has_any:dynamic=dynamic([]), eventtype:string='*', hashes_has_any:dynamic=dynamic([]), disabled:bool=false) {
    HalcyonEventsV2_CL
    | where not(disabled)
        and class_uid == 1007                                    // OCSF Process Activity
        and (isnull(starttime) or coalesce(HalcyonSourceTime, TimeGenerated) >= starttime)
        and (isnull(endtime)   or coalesce(HalcyonSourceTime, TimeGenerated) <= endtime)
        and (eventtype == '*' or eventtype =~ 'ProcessCreated')   // Halcyon Process Activity is always activity_id 1 (Launch -> ProcessCreated)
    // Pushdown filters on raw OCSF fields.
    // NOTE: dvcipaddr_has_any_prefix is not applicable - Halcyon device carries hostname/uid only, no IP.
    // NOTE: parentprocess_has_any is not applicable - only parent PID is emitted, no parent process name.
    // Short-circuit both non-applicable filters: a caller filtering on them gets no rows rather than unfiltered data.
    | where array_length(dvcipaddr_has_any_prefix) == 0
        and array_length(parentprocess_has_any) == 0
        and (array_length(commandline_has_all) == 0 or tostring(process.cmd_line) has_all (commandline_has_all))
        and (array_length(commandline_has_any) == 0 or tostring(process.cmd_line) has_any (commandline_has_any))
        and (array_length(commandline_has_any_ip_prefix) == 0 or has_any_ipv4_prefix(tostring(process.cmd_line), commandline_has_any_ip_prefix))
        and (array_length(actingprocess_has_any) == 0 or tostring(actor.process.file.name) has_any (actingprocess_has_any))
        and (array_length(targetprocess_has_any) == 0 or tostring(process.file.name) has_any (targetprocess_has_any))
        and (targetusername_has == '*' or tostring(actor.['user'].name) has targetusername_has)
        and (array_length(dvchostname_has_any) == 0 or tostring(device.hostname) has_any (dvchostname_has_any))
        and (array_length(hashes_has_any) == 0 or tostring(process.file.hashes[0].value) has_any (hashes_has_any) or tostring(actor.process.file.hashes[0].value) has_any (hashes_has_any))
    | extend
        EventType        = case(activity_id == 1, "ProcessCreated", activity_id == 2, "ProcessTerminated", "ProcessCreated"),
        TargetProcessId           = tostring(process.pid),
        TargetProcessName         = tostring(process.file.path),          // full image path
        TargetProcessCommandLine  = tostring(process.cmd_line),           // not populated for pre-execution blocks; populated when a command line was captured
        TargetProcessSHA256       = tostring(process.file.hashes[0].value),  // hashes[0] is always SHA-256
        ActingProcessId           = tostring(actor.process.pid),
        ActingProcessName         = tostring(actor.process.file.path),
        ActingProcessCommandLine  = tostring(actor.process.cmd_line),
        ActingProcessSHA256       = tostring(actor.process.file.hashes[0].value),
        ParentProcessId           = tostring(actor.process.parent_process.pid),
        ActorUsername             = tostring(actor.['user'].name),
        ActorUserId               = tostring(actor.['user'].uid),
        TargetUsername            = tostring(actor.['user'].name),         // launched process runs in the actor user context
        TargetUserId              = tostring(actor.['user'].uid),
        DvcId                     = tostring(device.uid),
        DvcHostname_raw           = tostring(device.hostname),
        EventOriginalSeverity     = tostring(severity)
    | invoke _ASIM_ResolveDvcFQDN('DvcHostname_raw')
    | extend
        Hash       = TargetProcessSHA256,
        HashType   = iff(isnotempty(TargetProcessSHA256), "SHA256", ""),
        // Security verdict drives EventResult/DvcAction, NOT status_id. Block (action_id 2) => Failure/Block
        // (launch prevented), Report (action_id 1) => Success/Allow, per Halcyon's security verdict mapping.
        EventResult = case(action_id == 2, "Failure", action_id == 1, "Success", "NA"),
        DvcAction   = case(action_id == 2, "Block", action_id == 1, "Allow", ""),
        EventSeverity = case(
                            EventOriginalSeverity in~ ("Informational", "Info"), "Informational",
                            EventOriginalSeverity =~ "Low", "Low",
                            EventOriginalSeverity =~ "Medium", "Medium",
                            EventOriginalSeverity in~ ("High", "Critical", "Fatal"), "High",
                            EventOriginalSeverity =~ "Unknown", "Informational",
                            "Informational"),
        TargetUsernameType = _ASIM_GetUsernameType(tostring(actor.['user'].name)),
        TargetUserType     = _ASIM_GetUserType(tostring(actor.['user'].name), ""),
        TargetUserIdType   = case(isempty(tostring(actor.['user'].uid)), "", tostring(actor.['user'].uid) startswith "S-1-", "SID", "Other"),
        ActorUsernameType  = _ASIM_GetUsernameType(tostring(actor.['user'].name)),
        ActorUserType      = _ASIM_GetUserType(tostring(actor.['user'].name), ""),
        ActorUserIdType    = case(isempty(tostring(actor.['user'].uid)), "", tostring(actor.['user'].uid) startswith "S-1-", "SID", "Other"),
        DvcIdType   = iff(isnotempty(DvcId), "Other", ""),
        EventStartTime = coalesce(HalcyonSourceTime, TimeGenerated)
    | extend
        Dvc          = coalesce(DvcId, DvcHostname),
        EventEndTime = EventStartTime,
        User         = TargetUsername,
        Process      = TargetProcessName,
        CommandLine  = TargetProcessCommandLine,
        EventCount   = int(1),
        EventUid     = HalcyonEventId,
        EventOriginalUid = HalcyonEventId,
        EventMessage = tostring(message),
        EventOriginalType = tostring(type_name),
        EventOriginalSubType = tostring(activity_name),
        EventProduct = "Halcyon",
        EventVendor  = "Halcyon",
        EventSchema  = "ProcessEvent",
        EventSchemaVersion = "0.1.4",
        AdditionalFields = bag_pack(
                              "halcyon_alert_id",   tostring(unmapped.halcyon_alert_id),
                              "halcyon_tenant_id",  tostring(unmapped.halcyon_tenant_id),
                              "halcyon_event_kind", tostring(unmapped.halcyon_event_kind)
                          )
    // Project only ASIM ProcessEvent/Common output columns (avoids project-away so new source columns don't leak into output).
    | project
        TimeGenerated,
        Type,
        EventType,
        TargetProcessId,
        TargetProcessName,
        TargetProcessCommandLine,
        TargetProcessSHA256,
        ActingProcessId,
        ActingProcessName,
        ActingProcessCommandLine,
        ActingProcessSHA256,
        ParentProcessId,
        ActorUsername,
        ActorUserId,
        TargetUsername,
        TargetUserId,
        DvcId,
        EventOriginalSeverity,
        DvcHostname,
        DvcFQDN,
        DvcDomain,
        DvcDomainType,
        Hash,
        HashType,
        EventResult,
        DvcAction,
        EventSeverity,
        TargetUsernameType,
        TargetUserType,
        TargetUserIdType,
        ActorUsernameType,
        ActorUserType,
        ActorUserIdType,
        DvcIdType,
        EventStartTime,
        Dvc,
        EventEndTime,
        User,
        Process,
        CommandLine,
        EventCount,
        EventUid,
        EventOriginalUid,
        EventMessage,
        EventOriginalType,
        EventOriginalSubType,
        EventProduct,
        EventVendor,
        EventSchema,
        EventSchemaVersion,
        AdditionalFields
};
parser(starttime=starttime, endtime=endtime, commandline_has_any=commandline_has_any, commandline_has_all=commandline_has_all, commandline_has_any_ip_prefix=commandline_has_any_ip_prefix, actingprocess_has_any=actingprocess_has_any, targetprocess_has_any=targetprocess_has_any, parentprocess_has_any=parentprocess_has_any, targetusername_has=targetusername_has, dvcipaddr_has_any_prefix=dvcipaddr_has_any_prefix, dvchostname_has_any=dvchostname_has_any, eventtype=eventtype, hashes_has_any=hashes_has_any, disabled=disabled)
